title: The Stolen #treasure_word.title#
A Thief in the Night
What Was Taken
tale_theft.hook: Somebody has stolen {treasure} from {victim}, and {victim} has not slept since. Fingers point in every direction, but more than one of them points at {villain}.

resolutions.title: Return what was taken
resolutions.text: {target.The} takes {means} in both hands and, for a long moment, says nothing at all. Then: "Thank you."
{target.The} falls. Whatever they took, they won't be taking anything else.

lore.title: The theft
lore.text: {treasure.The} vanished on a night with no moon. {victim.The} swears they heard footsteps, then nothing.

lore.title: A suspect
lore.text: {villain.The} has been spending money nobody knew they had. They always did want to {villain.motive}.

tale_theft.ending: {treasure.The} is back where it belongs, and {victim} keeps it closer than ever. As for {villain}, nobody sees them on the roads again.

title: The Blight
Ashes in the Well
The Sickening
tale_blight.hook: A blight has crept over {place}. Plants wither, milk sours, and people speak in whispers. It all seems to spread from {heart}.
tale_blight.goal: Find {remedy} and use it on {heart} in {place} to lift the blight.

resolutions.title: Lift the blight
resolutions.text: You use {means} on {target}. Something like a long-held breath goes out of the world, and colour creeps back into everything.

lore.title: Where the blight began
lore.text: The blight began at {heart}. First the grass around it died, then the birds stopped singing there.

lore.title: Whose doing?
lore.text: Some say the blight is {villain}'s work. {villain.The} has always wanted to {villain.motive}.

tale_blight.ending: The blight lifts. By spring you would never know it had been there, except that people smile at you in the street, and you can't quite remember why.

title: The Missing
Gone Without a Word
Lost
tale_missing.hook: {missing.The} has vanished. Nobody saw them go, nobody knows where, and the longer it goes on the worse the guesses get.
tale_missing.goal: Find {missing} and make sure they're safe.

resolutions.title: Found
resolutions.text: {target.The} stares at you, then laughs with relief. "I thought nobody would ever come."

lore.title: Last seen
lore.text: The last anyone saw of {missing}, they were asking strangers about the road out of town.

tale_missing.ending: {missing.The} comes home. They don't talk much about where they were, but they leave a candle burning in the window every night after.

tale_thief.name: #tale_name#
tale_thief.appearance: {self.Name} is lurking here, trying very hard to look like they belong.
tale_thief.description: Quick hands, quick eyes, and an expensive coat that doesn't quite fit.

goals: sell what they stole before anyone notices

tale_heirloom.name: #heirloom#
tale_heirloom.description: Small, old, and worth far more to its owner than to anyone else.

tale_remedy.name: #remedy#
tale_remedy.description: Whatever it is, it is the one thing that can stop the blight.

tale_shrine_stone.name: blackened stone
tale_shrine_stone.appearance: A blackened stone sits here, and the ground around it is grey and dead.
tale_shrine_stone.description: It is cold to the touch, colder than stone should be, and nothing grows within a stride of it.
